# PJR Team

> Healthcare digital governance partner for skilled nursing, senior living, and healthcare organizations — websites, social, reputation, reviews, and technology oversight.

PJR Team helps healthcare leaders control their digital front door: who has access, what gets published, how reviews are answered, and how online reputation affects census and referrals.

## Priority pages

- [Home](https://www.pjrteam.com/): Healthcare digital governance, reputation, and web partnership overview
- [Improve Your Census](https://www.pjrteam.com/census): How reviews, search, and staff turnover cost skilled nursing admissions — free census check
- [Services](https://www.pjrteam.com/services): Full service overview for operators
- [Digital governance & social](https://www.pjrteam.com/services/digital-governance): Social media governance, access control, and HIPAA-aware publishing for healthcare
- [Reputation & risk](https://www.pjrteam.com/services/reputation-risk): Google reviews, online reputation, and risk response for SNF and senior living
- [Facility Dashboards & Smart Workflows](https://www.pjrteam.com/services/facility-dashboards): A dedicated login for each facility, with its assets in one place, organized and available for use, plus AI-assisted review responses that are always approved by a PJR specialist and screened for HIPAA before they post.
- [Websites & digital foundations](https://www.pjrteam.com/services/websites-digital-foundations): Healthcare website rebrands and digital foundations
- [Technology & security](https://www.pjrteam.com/services/technology-security): Technology oversight and security for healthcare digital presence
- [Partnership & support](https://www.pjrteam.com/services/partnership-support): Ongoing digital partnership and support
- [News & insights](https://www.pjrteam.com/news): CMS ratings, census, Google reputation, and digital governance guidance
- [Results](https://www.pjrteam.com/results): Client testimonials and logos, including work beyond healthcare
- [Founder](https://www.pjrteam.com/founder): Brittney Davis, founder of PJR Team
- [Mission](https://www.pjrteam.com/mission): Mission, vision, and values
